description: AI companion toys for neurodivergent children promise connection and therapy, but can they deliver for the long haul? This story was written by Sara Harrison and narrated by Noa - newsoveraudio.com. Listen to more of the world's best journalism on the Noa app.
classificationReason: Centers on AI companion robots used for connection and therapy with neurodivergent children, including long-term effects of the physical robot relationship.
qualityReason: Focused journalism on a specific embodied-AI product category, though it is narrated reporting rather than an original technical interview.
